title: Bitstamp Public API v2: BTC/USD OHLC
author: Bitstamp

chunks.heading: Public OHLC
chunks.body: Bitstamp exposes public BTC/USD OHLC data with explicit step, limit, start and end controls. The academy queries bounded windows in memory and stores only parity statistics.

chunks.heading: Use boundary
chunks.body: Bitstamp directs commercial exchange-data users to a data license agreement. This academy does not redistribute raw candles and treats the feed only as a candidate research proxy pending parity gates.
